parole.significato: A court of justice.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Hindustani عدالت / अदालत (adālat), from Classical Persian عدالت ('adālat).

parole.significato: Freedom, independence.

parole.significato: An almond.

parole.significato: A long whip formerly used as an instrument of punishment in India and parts of the Middle East.

parole.testo: Borrowed from Hindustani دربار / दरबार (darbār), in turn borrowed from Classical Persian دربار (darbār, “royal court”).

parole.significato: A member of an ethnic group of North India and Pakistan, traditionally working as barbers.

parole.significato: A doctor, usually practicing traditional medicine.
parole.testo: From Hindustani حکیم / हकीम (hakīm), from Classical Persian حکیم (hakīm), from Arabic حَكِيم (ḥakīm, “wise, learned”).

parole.significato: A bastard.

parole.significato: A grain.

parole.significato: Honour, pride; reputation.

parole.significato: Magic, sorcery.

parole.significato: A record keeper involved in the administration of the pargana.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Hindustani कारकुन (kārkun) / کارکن, from Classical Persian کار کن (kār-kun, “worker”).

parole.significato: A dull, yellowish-brown colour, the colour of dust.

parole.significato: A plot of land.

parole.significato: A male servant, with responsibility for waiting at table.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Hindustani خدمتگار (xidmatgār) / ख़िदमतगार, from Classical Persian خدمتگار (xidmatgār).

parole.significato: A curry made from various spices especially coriander and cumin; and often with yoghurt sauce or nuts.

parole.significato: a Christian.

parole.significato: Shortbread biscuit popular in the Indian subcontinent.

parole.significato: The custodian of a waqf, or Islamic endowment.

parole.significato: Cooked in a tandoor.

parole.significato: Saffron.
